subject: sounds
title: Clap the syllables
about: Clap a word and tap how many syllables it has, from one to four. NC RF.1.4.d asks him to use the rule that every syllable has a vowel sound to count syllables in a printed word.
tip: Clap it together, or put a hand under his chin: it drops once per syllable.

cards.q: How many syllables are in cat? Clap it.
cards.sayQ: How many syllables are in cat? cat. Clap it.
cards.note: cat. 1 clap. Every syllable has a vowel sound.
